messages:
Ajay (AE): Parallax Media just escalated — they want a Private deployment with VPC private control plane + KMS/HSM, model pinning, audit logs, and a 99.95% availability SLA for their ad-serving pipeline. Theyre asking for delivery by 2025-07-15. Contract review next week. Can we commit?

Maria (PM): Thanks Ajay. Need to clarify MVP scope. Which features are must-have for them to consider this "Private deploy"? Also which rollout path: VPC private control plane first or full on-prem from day one?

Ajay (AE): They prefer VPC private control plane + customer-managed networking. On-prem can be a later phase. Core must-haves: model pinning + versioning, audit logs exported to their SIEM, KMS/HSM integration, per-route cost visibility.

Sophie (SE): Tech note: VPC private control plane + standard KMS integrations (AWS/GCP) is straightforward. HSMs and on-prem shims add complexity. Ballpark: 6w for KMS integrations (VPC path), 10w for on-prem packaging/airgap support (installer, certs, local KMS shim).

Daniel (Eng): From runtime side: model pinning + canary rollouts = mostly config+api work (approx 4 eng-weeks). Audit logs + SIEM export is heavier (approx 8 eng-weeks). Need dedicated infra acceptance window. If we reassign 2 engineers from Optimize for 6 weeks we can hit the VPC scope faster. Risk: infra testing windows may add ~2w.

Leo (CS): Procurement timeline is tight — they expect signed SOW by end of next month or they escalate to alternatives. They'll accept staged delivery (VPC first, on-prem later) if we guarantee data isolation + KMS controls.

Maria (PM): Proposed committed milestone (MVP for commitment):
1) VPC private control plane + KMS integration (AWS KMS + GCP KMS)
2) Model pinning + versioning API and UI
3) Audit logs with SIEM export and retention controls
4) Canary rollout + automatic fallback policy
5) High-level on-prem packaging plan (no air-gapped GA in MVP)
Target: Q3 canary start (canary begins 8 weeks after SOW). Agree/disagree?

Daniel (Eng): That matches our estimates. Critical path = KMS integration + audit pipeline. If product reprioritizes Optimize items we can move two engineers for 6 weeks. Still, calendar risk exists.

Sophie (SE): Security asks: we need Parallaxs SOC2 scope and KMS key rotation policy, plus a contact for their security team. Also we should prepare a KMS compromise runbook.

Ajay (AE): I'll request SOC2 and KMS docs today and push the SOW deadline to 2025-04-01 (customer said they can aim for that).

Maria (PM): Tentative decision: we can commit to a Q3 canary start if SOW is signed by 2025-04-01. Action items:
- Ajay: collect SOC2/KMS docs and confirm SOW timeline
- Daniel: confirm infra acceptance cluster slot by Fri
- Sophie: draft KMS/runbook checklist
- Leo: draft CS onboarding/go-no-go checklist
Ill reflect this in the roadmap and OKR board.

Daniel (Eng): Confirmed: acceptance cluster placeholder reserved for Q3 week1 (pending final infra approval).

infra-bot: Deployment window reserved: acceptance-cluster-2025-q3-week1

Leo (CS): Parallax informed. They asked for a simple go/no-go checklist — Ill share by EOD tomorrow.

Maria (PM): Thanks team. Ill add an entry to the product roadmap doc and tag it with "customer-commitment: parallax-media" on the OKR board. Well revisit if SOW slips. :white_check_mark:

Ajay (AE): Thanks — will update this thread when I have SOC2/KMS docs.

(END)
